01380 G@bal {ge-val'}

源自 01379 (取其"連綿丘陵"之意 ); 專有名詞 地名

欽定本 - Gebal 1; 1

迦巴勒 = "山"
1) 在推羅附近, 地屬腓尼基的濱海城鎮, 以 Byblus 的名為希臘人所知,
   現在的 Jebeil (#結 27:9|)
record.edic_text:
01380 G@bal {gheb-al'}

from 01379 (in the sense of a chain of hills);; n pr loc

AV - Gebal 1; 1

Gebal = "mountain"
1) a maritime town of Phoenicia near Tyre (modern 'Jebeil') known to
   the Greeks as 'Byblus'
